mentions.name: Gradual wake-time Android alarm app
mentions.description: An Android alarm app that wakes the user up one minute earlier each day, gradually shifting alarm times until they reach their wake-time goal.
mentions.source_excerpt: Finally being able to build something I've wanted for years: an alarm app that wakes me up 1 min earlier each day until I reach my wake time goal.
